non_blocking_notes: Evidence callback executes under lock (by design) to protect reentrancy—correct per test_reentrant_evidence_callback test
Request ID sanitization via _text() is consistent with existing pattern for grant fields
Audit parameter is optional but admit() requires it (Evidence unavailable error)—proper fail-safe design
result.reasoning_summary: Commit 87dda89c implements FW-MCP-01 replay-protected exact request admission. All requirements verified: deny-by-default enforcement via grant membership check, bounded request IDs via single-use tracking under RLock, concurrent and reentrant replay protection demonstrated across 8-thread pool and callback reentrancy tests, revoked/cross-tenant denial validated, Evidence-first rollback semantics with proper exception rollback, backward compatibility of allows() method, thread-safe lock usage on all mutations, and absence of tool execution (DRY_RUN mode, tool_executed=False) and prohibited operations. Patch is narrow and focused. Tests comprehensively cover normal path, failure modes, concurrency, and edge cases. Deterministic checks passed (110 tests, git diff --check).
